text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Overactive Bladder (Primary Non-Neurogenic)

Given the normal urinalysis, negative culture, low post-void residual, normal pelvic floor, normal bladder ultrasound, and a cystoscopy showing normal urethra and bladder mucosa, infection, stones, tumors, and structural defects are ruled out. The combination of chronic discomfort and frequent urination without these secondary causes is most consistent with a functional disorder like overactive bladder or bladder pain syndrome.
